The suspect, Calvin Darifeth, was taken to a local hospital where he succumbed to his injuries the following day. A slow motion replay of the officer's body cam revealed Calvin shooting at the officer first before the officer fired back. This isn't Calvin's first run-in with the law, as he was previously placed on juvenile probation when he was 15 for an incident in February. 2020, where he discharged a rifle loaded with a 22-caliber bullet in a residence. He was charged with discharge of a firearm into a habitation with the intent to cause harm or panic, a second-degree felony, if committed by an adult. In the same month, he was charged with marijuana possession, where he was found with a THC vape pen in Findlay High School. In May 2022, he was charged with assault after assaulting another juvenile for allegedly snitching on him. In January, 2023, he was charged with assault again after fighting a student at school. In March 2023, he was charged with theft of a motor vehicle and receiving stolen property, where he and another juvenile were charged for stealing a 9mm firearm and a car from the other juvenile's mother. In October 2024, he was charged with theft, where he and three other individuals were involved in shoplifting a bottle of alcohol from Walmart. As of December 2024, the Hancock County Prosecutor's Office determined that the officer's actions were justified within reason and closed the case. Thank you.
